chapter.heading: Deuteronomy 13
chapter.v: a dreamer of dreams arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder,
the sign or wonder that he tells you comes to pass, and if he says, ‘Let us go after other gods,’ which you have not known, ‘and let us serve them,’
is testing you, to know whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
which neither you nor your fathers have known,
of the gods of the peoples who are around you, whether near you or far off from you, from the one end of the earth to the other,
shall your eye pity him, nor shall you spare him, nor shall you conceal him.
Your hand shall be first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.
You shall stone him to death with stones, because he sought to draw you away from the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
all Israel shall hear and fear and never again do any such wickedness as this among you.
“If you hear in one of your cities, which the Lord your God is giving you to dwell there,
worthless fellows have gone out among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, ‘Let us go and serve other gods,’ which you have not known,
diligently. And behold, if it be true and certain that such an abomination has been done among you,
you shall surely put the inhabitants of that city to the sword, devoting it to destruction, all who are in it and its cattle, with the edge of the sword.
heap forever. It shall not be built again.
as he swore to your fathers,
keeping all his commandments that I am commanding you today, and doing what is right in the sight of the Lord your God.
